lines: The USA was divided into grid cells.
Each cell contains an interpolated proportion
of high counts in bird observations,
based on the routes relevant to that cell.
The population count is global.

climate_preferences.title: For further info hover over visual elements
lines: The total range of the variable was binned and each bin
associated with its proportion of high counts
in bird observations.
Yellow: Total variable range relevant for the species
Red: Range with optimal conditions for the species
Dotted Marker: Absolute Optimum (if given)

habitat_preferences.title: For further info hover over visual elements
lines: Each habitat type was associated with its proportion
of high counts in bird observations.
Based on that a preferred habitat was approximated.
Water Access and Urbanization Tolerance were excluded
from the original habitat types.
Each species was assigned a percentage based
on the full range of water proportions
observed across all species.
Each species was classified regarding its
developed area proportion compared to
the full proportion range
observed across all species.
Low vs. Mid vs. High:
Optimum positioning in total range
Adaptive vs. Rigid: Width of urbanization range
